steps.title: 1. Add your text
steps.body: Open Check a text. Paste a passage or scan a photo, then tap Check text.

steps.title: 2. Tap a word
steps.body: See its details and related forms. To look up a word on its own, use Find words.

steps.title: 3. Mark words to explain
steps.body: Choose May need explaining for any use your class needs help with. Find your marks in Words to explain.

steps.title: 4. Keep and copy words
steps.body: Tap Add to save a word. In Selected words, add a note and copy your choices.

example.sentence: Some students felt stressed before the test.
example.body: Tap stressed to see stress, stressful and other forms. Save the ones you want, then add a note: feel stressed / a stressful situation.

columns: Word / word form
One spelling, such as stressed. Its textbook and grade records refer to that spelling.
Word family
Related forms, such as stress, stressed and stressful. Their meanings can differ.
All words / Familiar words
All words searches the full database. Familiar words uses general English familiarity estimates of 3.5 or above. These estimates are separate from your marks about your class.
90% / 95% lists
These lists covered at least 90% or 95% of the words counted in each of four Hong Kong text collections. The 95% list includes the 90% list. Your own passage may differ.
Overall family rank
A combined rank from British, American and Hong Kong English records. Available scores have equal weight. Rank 1 is highest.
HK family rank / band
Ranks families using Hong Kong school materials, speech and writing (ICE-HK), web texts (GloWbE-HK) and news (NOW-HK). Available scores have equal weight. Rank 1 is highest; bands group the ranks.
First seen in HK textbooks
The earliest sampled textbook stage with this spelling: P1–P6 or S1–S6. Students may learn it at another stage.
US grade reference
A US school-grade reference for this spelling. Use it alongside your knowledge of the class.
Academic Word List (AWL)
Whether this spelling has an Academic Word List record.
Middle School Vocabulary List (MSVL)
Subject-list records for this spelling, such as Science or Health.
Greek/Latin root / Root meaning
A recorded root and its meaning. The whole word may mean something different.
Prefix / Suffix
Recorded parts at the start or end of the word.
Sort related words
Orders spellings by their counts in ICE-HK and GloWbE-HK. Your search stays first. Family ranks use the wider set of sources above.
View / Add
View opens the details. Add saves that spelling in Selected words.
A dash means no value or list entry is recorded. A zero is a recorded count of zero.
